title: Ayam Abang, Cili Saya
genre: Malay folk-tune modern pop (pop moden bernuansa tradisional)
subject: a wife whose twelve new chilli plants by the back fence are dug up every day by her husband's three free-range kampung hens, until he offers her one warm egg a day as rent for the garden
caption: Malay folk-tune modern pop (pop moden bernuansa tradisional) built on a playground game-song melody, in the mid-2020s AJL style. A kompang frame-drum ensemble playing interlocking procession patterns; a gendang ibu and gendang anak pair driving a bouncing two-bar cycle; a bamboo seruling flute answering every vocal line; a clean, bright electric guitar chopping the offbeats; round synth bass under a tight modern pop drum kit. Clean, bright radio mix with dry, close percussion and a short room reverb. Female lead with a bright mid-register chest voice and a playful, teasing half-spoken delivery, a small group of women shouting the chant back. 116 BPM, D major. Cheeky, sunny and domestic. No dangdut, no EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no joget accordion.
lyrics:
[Intro - kompang pattern and bamboo seruling, then the full band]

[Verse 1]
Pagi Sabtu aku tanam cili padi
Dua belas pokok tepi pagar belakang
Abang sumpah ayam dia tak pandai mencuri
Petang tu yang tinggal cuma lubang-lubang

[Pre-Chorus]
Si Merah korek, si Tompok jaga
Si Gemuk duduk atas guni baja

[Chorus]
Kok kok kek, ayam abang
Pagar aku dia buat tangga
Kok kok kek, jangan pandang-pandang
Malam ni nak makan kari, bang?

[Verse 2]
Hari Ahad aku pasang jaring biru
Isnin pagi jaring tu jadi buaian
Abang gelak, kata ayam pun nak tahu
Rasa cili yang aku jaga macam intan

[Chorus]
Kok kok kek, ayam abang
Pagar aku dia buat tangga
Kok kok kek, jangan pandang-pandang
Sabtu ni kita buat kenduri, bang?

[Bridge - kompang and gendang only]
Abang hulur sebiji telur, masih suam dalam tangan
"Ni sewa tanah," katanya, "cili kau aku jaga"

[Chorus]
Kok kok kek, ayam abang
Sebiji telur, satu pokok cili
Kok kok kek, kita berdamai
Tapi si Gemuk, jangan datang lagi!

[Outro - kompang and seruling trade the hook, band stops on one hit]
